title: Take Charge of My Heart
cast: Kim Young Kwang, Chae Soo Bin
summary: An inventive romantic comedy about Baek Ho Rang, a man whose artificial heart is running out of power, and Na Bo Bae, a woman with a surprising ability to recharge him.
trailerLabel: Official Netflix title page / available trailer
whyFans: The artificial-heart premise adds a playful fantasy twist to a modern romantic comedy.
The unusual connection between the leads creates room for comic misunderstandings and emotional growth.
The high-concept setup gives the series an instantly recognisable hook.
review: Take Charge of My Heart stands out with a high-concept meet-cute: one lead needs an artificial-heart recharge, while the other has an unusual electrical ability. That offers a clear comic engine, but the emotional payoff will depend on how the story develops their vulnerabilities beyond the fantasy gimmick. The premise is distinctive and easy to remember.
